quests.title: A Toast to the Boss
quests.summary: Get your boots past biosecurity, collect a tot, toast Shackleton at his grave and show a king penguin chick to the counter.

steps.text: Get your boots cleared by the biosecurity officer on the street.
Collect a tot for the Boss from the museum shop.
Toast Shackleton at his grave in the whalers' cemetery.
Catch an Oakling and show it to the penguin counter on Salisbury Plain.
Tell the museum guide how it went.

quests.reward: A Hip Flask (survives one knockout a battle) and three Hot Blackcurrants.

quests.title: Pipit Patrol
quests.summary: Find a Tussipit in the tussac grass and show it to the scientist at King Edward Point.

steps.text: Catch a Tussipit in the tussac grass and show the ranger.
Show the scientist at the King Edward Point research station.
